violation_type.title: Infant Care Area - Safe, Open Floor Space (26 TAC §746.2403(2))
violation_type.short_title: Infant Care Area - Safe, Open Floor Space
violation_type.typical_finding: There is sufficient evidence to show that a soft play structure was positioned too close to the unpadded floor and not more on the carpeted area.

finding_variants.text: There is sufficient evidence to show that a soft play structure was positioned too close to the unpadded floor and not more on the carpeted area.
This standard was found to be deficient as both infant classrooms were not set up to include safe, open floor space for floor time play during the inspection.

I observed the infant classroom floor space filled with items/objects the director mentioned were used as floating items/objects. Items included travel shelves, cots, and bowling balls and pins.       Note: The area was cleared of all hazards before the inspection concluded.

Observed infant classroom not organized as sink was full with items, changing table had items on time, and one crib in the corner with items inside. The floor space was not set up for the infants at the tiime of inspection.
